_note: Uncle Bob's lines. "id" names the recorded clip, sayings/voices/<id>.mp3, made by tools/make-voices.mjs, which also sets "voiced". "day" lines open each scenery (js/levels.js names its line). "trash" lines are for sharing a score, never spoken; {score} and {day} are filled in.

day.text: Hey, let's go feed those chickens!
Watch out for that wolf. If he shows up, give him a good punch!
Corn's high this year. Keep your eyes peeled for that wolf.
Rained all night. Mud's deep, so watch your step!
It's dark out here. Wolves love the dark.
Brr! Cold chickens get hungry fast!
Look at all the little chicks! Their mamas need feeding.
Pumpkin time! Don't trip over those vines.
County fair today! Keep that prize hen fat and happy.
Back at it! These chickens are hungrier than ever.

empty.text: Bucket's empty! Back to the feed bin.

stolen.text: Hey! Come back with my chicken!

sundown.text: Every one of 'em fed and happy.

trash.text: I kept Uncle Bob's chickens alive till day {day} for {score} points. Your chickens would starve.
{score} points on Feed the Chickens. The wolf is scared of ME now.
Made it to day {day} with {score} points. Bet you can't even find the feed bin.
